entries.10df3122b06dd300: The company develops and manufactures electronic components and related products and sells them to customers and sales companies in Japan and overseas. Murata Manufacturing itself makes semi-finished products, which are intermediate products of electronic components, and supplies them to production companies in Japan and overseas, and the production companies process them into finished products, deliver them to the company itself and to sales companies, and they are sold to customers. The components do not reach consumers on their own, but are incorporated and used in devices such as smartphones, servers, automobiles, and game consoles. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, there was no customer that accounted for more than 10% of revenue.
